description: Per-source minimum row count floors used by validate_api_data_contract. Floors are set at roughly 80% of the current live baseline so a scrape regression that drops a source below its floor will trip a warning (or error if the count hits zero). Tunable without a code change. Floors for the nine sources added 2026-11-08 (W05-F004) are derived from git-tracked CSV history by scripts/derive_source_row_floors.py; rule and evidence in docs/sources/SOURCE_ROW_FLOORS.md. 'ceilings' are report-only (source_above_expected), never a refusal.
